description: This file defines the CatalogWorker class, a utility class providing static methods for managing product catalogs within the Ofbiz framework. It includes functions for retrieving catalogs, categories, and related properties, often based on request parameters or session data.

classes.name: CatalogWorker
classes.description: A utility class containing static methods related to product catalog management, such as retrieving catalog IDs, categories, names, and configuration flags within the Ofbiz framework.

methods.name: getWebSiteId
methods.description: Deprecated method to retrieve website ID from request, using WebSiteWorker.

methods.name: getWebSite
methods.description: Deprecated method to retrieve website information from request, using WebSiteWorker.

methods.name: getAllCatalogIds
methods.description: Returns a list of all catalog IDs ordered by catalog name.

methods.name: getStoreCatalogs
methods.description: Retrieves catalogs associated with the current product store or specified delegator and store ID.

methods.name: getPartyCatalogs
methods.description: Fetches catalogs associated with the user's party (customer), based on session data.

methods.name: getProdCatalogCategories
methods.description: Retrieves categories for a given catalog, optionally filtered by category type.

methods.name: getCurrentCatalogId
methods.description: Determines the current catalog ID from request parameters, session, or defaults to the first available catalog.

methods.name: getCatalogIdsAvailable
methods.description: Compiles a list of catalog IDs available based on party and store catalogs.

methods.name: getCatalogName
methods.description: Fetches the name of a catalog by ID.

methods.name: getContentPathPrefix
methods.description: Returns the content path prefix for the current catalog.

methods.name: getTemplatePathPrefix
methods.description: Returns the template path prefix for the current catalog.

methods.name: getProdCatalog
methods.description: Retrieves the product catalog entity for the current or specified catalog ID.

methods.name: getProdCatalogCategoryId
methods.description: Gets the product category ID for a specific catalog and category type.

methods.name: getCatalogTopCategoryId
methods.description: Fetches the top-level category ID for a catalog, defaults to root browse category.

methods.name: getCatalogSearchCategoryId
methods.description: Obtains the search category ID for a catalog.

methods.name: getCatalogViewAllowCategoryId
methods.description: Gets the category ID that allows viewing all items.

methods.name: getCatalogPurchaseAllowCategoryId
methods.description: Gets the category ID that allows purchasing items.

methods.name: getCatalogPromotionsCategoryId
methods.description: Retrieves the promotions category ID for a catalog.

methods.name: getCatalogQuickaddUse
methods.description: Determines if quick add is enabled for the catalog.

methods.name: getCatalogQuickaddCategoryPrimary
methods.description: Gets the primary category ID for quick add.

methods.name: getCatalogQuickaddCategories
methods.description: Returns categories used for quick add operations.

methods.name: getCatalogTopEbayCategoryId
methods.description: Retrieves the eBay root category ID for the catalog.
